user.title: Connect to Dahua ARC
user.description: Connect locally to a Dahua ARC alarm hub. The integration is read-only: it discovers the ARC hub, paired radio devices, MultiIO wired inputs, wireless sensors, sirens, repeaters, keyfobs/keypads, alarm-related configuration, capabilities, and realtime event codes.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Dahua ARC hub.

behavior.title: Dahua ARC behavior
behavior.description: Choose the authoritative safety reconciliation interval and optionally let Dahua ARC intelligently place location-bearing alarm entities into existing Home Assistant areas.

data.auto_area_match: Smartly assign devices and sensors to Home Assistant areas

data_description.periodic_resync_seconds: A local DHIP snapshot verifies current AlarmIn states if a realtime event was missed. 300 seconds is recommended.
data_description.auto_area_match: Uses Dahua AlarmSubSystem room assignments first, then local sensor names, and matches them against your existing Home Assistant area names and aliases. Ambiguous matches are skipped.
data_description.enable_research_features: Off by default. Enables experimental PIRCam snapshot camera, detector-test buttons, and LowRateWPAN polling/subscription diagnostics. Leave disabled for production wired-zone operation.

area_match.title: Smart area matching
area_match.description: Choose which Home Assistant areas are eligible. Dahua's own subsystem/area assignment is preferred when available; sensor names, aliases and fuzzy room terminology are used as a fallback. Ambiguous matches are refused.

data_description.area_match_areas: Only selected areas are considered. This is useful when similarly named rooms exist.
data_description.area_match_threshold: Higher values are more conservative. 78% is recommended.

area_preview.title: Review smart area matching
area_preview.description:

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Dahua ARC
reauth_confirm.description: Update the local Dahua ARC credentials for {host}.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Dahua ARC
reconfigure.description: Update the local connection details. The integration verifies the hub before saving and reloads automatically.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Dahua ARC hub.

no_primary_zones.description: The integration connected to the ARC hub but did not identify any primary alarm inputs to expose. Check the ARC Alarm table, MultiIO pairing, firmware, and diagnostics before relying on the integration.
